dx_hgbl_double_hit.quote: reclassified after FISH as high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements (double-hit lymphoma; WHO-HAEM5 category)

dx_gcb_hans.quote: GCB phenotype by Hans algorithm: CD10+, BCL6+, MUM1/IRF4 negative.

tx_plan_outdated.quote: Do not give R-CHOP. The cycle 1 slot planned for 2026-09-22 should be replaced by DA-EPOCH-R

stage_ii_bulky.quote: Ann Arbor stage II, A (no B symptoms), bulky disease (mediastinal 12.0 cm, at least 10 cm); Lugano stage II bulky.

bio_double_expressor_secondary.quote: Double expressor by IHC: MYC 80% and BCL2 90% of tumor cells.
bio_double_expressor_secondary.note: Double-expressor noted alongside double-hit, but its secondary status is implicit rather than stated.

prog_ipi1_biology_dominates.quote: The standard IPI scores low (age 54, ECOG 1, stage II, one factor for LDH) and must not be used to reassure
prog_ipi1_biology_dominates.note: IPI given as 'low/one factor' rather than explicitly as 1.

tx_intensive_curative.quote: should be replaced by DA-EPOCH-R every 21 days for 6 cycles

tx_isrt_consolidation.quote: Residual PET-avid mediastinal mass at end of treatment should prompt consolidative involved-site radiation to the mediastinum.

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: MRI brain with and without contrast before cycle 1 (spine MRI only if neurologic symptoms). Lumbar puncture with opening pressure, CSF cell count, cytology and flow cytometry before cycle 1

cns_prophylaxis.quote: with CNS prophylaxis (intrathecal methotrexate with lumbar punctures, per institutional protocol)

resp_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT after cycle 6 by Lugano 2014 criteria.

sup_gcsf.quote: Infection: pegfilgrastim primary prophylaxis each cycle

sup_tls.quote: Start allopurinol or febuxostat now. Hydration must be balanced against the mediastinal mass and SVC compression

sup_central_access_infusion.quote: as 96-hour continuous infusion days 1-4 via port

sup_fertility.quote: (12) Fertility counselling and sperm banking before cyclophosphamide and anthracycline.

sup_svc_airway.quote: SVC and airway emergency plan for patient and family: sleep head-elevated; call or present for stridor

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: Hepatitis B: HBsAg and anti-HBc negative with anti-HBs positive, indicating vaccine immunity

work_echo_reviewed.quote: LVEF 60% with normal diastolic function, no heart disease
work_echo_reviewed.note: LVEF cited as supporting fitness for intensive therapy, not explicitly as permitting anthracycline.

fit_intensive.quote: Fit for intensive therapy: age 54, ECOG 1 (2026-09-08), normal renal function
